claims.text: The datasets used in the experiment include the LibriSpeech corpus and the GlobalPhone corpus.
The LibriSpeech corpus consists of 960 hours of English audio data, while the GlobalPhone corpus includes French, German, Czech, and Spanish.
20 thousand segments from each language in the GlobalPhone corpus were used for calculating average cosine similarity.
